title: Upgraded Mac satellite re-links every few minutes but central never restores Active after its restart onto 8d838f90
outcome: The reason central does not restore the upgraded Mac to Active and verificationCurrent is identified from the per-attempt failure, and the Mac returns to Active by the designed automatic path or by a fix.
acceptance: The failing requalification or health step is identified with its quoted error or log line and the code path that produced it.

The cause is classified as Mac-side state, central defect or expected behaviour, with evidence; a defect gets a fix with a regression test and a clean review pair, and the Mac reaches Active and verificationCurrent on the new image.
